issuer.text: Anemoy Treasury Fund share class JTRSY; verify the current legal issuer and subscription documents directly with Anemoy before enabling investment.

yieldSource.text: The issuer describes a strategy investing in short-duration US Treasury bills. No current yield is supplied in this template.

redemption.text: The issuer describes daily redemptions. This adapter uses asynchronous requests and later claims; actual fulfillment and terms remain issuer-controlled.

risks.text: Review issuer, custody, liquidity, transfer restrictions, NAV changes, USDC and contract risk; tokenization does not guarantee capital or immediate exit.

eligibility.text: Issuer onboarding and wallet permission are required. Obtain current permitted jurisdictions, professional-investor criteria and actual minimum directly from the issuer; this template is deliberately disabled.

maturity.text: The issuer describes underlying Treasury bills of at most six months. That is not a maturity date for the fund token.
